name: Insignia Capacitive-Platform Inlet Valve (TWM41/TWM35)
purpose: NS-TWM41 / NS-TWM35 inlet solenoid coil — high-impedance coil vs WMT41 frequency platform.
failureModes: Open coil — E1 fill timeout
Shorted coil — inlet valve fault
testingTips: Disconnect power before coil ohms test
Do not confuse with WMT41 platform (4–6 Ω coils)

name: Insignia Capacitive-Platform Drain Pump (TWM41/TWM35)
purpose: TWM41/TWM35 drain pump winding — much lower than generic washer band.
failureModes: Open winding — E2 drain timeout
Normal ohms but no drain — impeller or clog
testingTips: Check drain hose and filter before pump replacement

name: Insignia Capacitive-Platform Door Lock (Blue-Blue)
purpose: Door locker coil between two blue wires — Fd door lock fault.
failureModes: Out of band — Fd / door lock failed
Latch bar position affects black-wire switch test
testingTips: Test blue-blue pair for coil; verify latch bar position for switch continuity

name: Insignia Capacitive Level Sensor (Term 1–3)
purpose: TWM41 capacitive water level sensor — also verify 40–50 nF between terminals.
failureModes: Out of band — F8 level sensor fault
Good nF but bad ohms — replace sensor
testingTips: Capacitance 40–50 nF between term 1–2 and 2–3 per TWM41 manual

name: Insignia Frequency-Platform Inlet Valve (WMT41)
purpose: WMT41WA5 inlet valve coil — low-impedance vs TWM41 kΩ coils.
failureModes: Open coil — fill timeout
Shorted coil — valve fault
testingTips: Measure across first and second coil terminals per service manual

name: Insignia Frequency-Platform Drain Motor (WMT41)
purpose: WMT41 retractor/drain motor Red–Light blue pair.
failureModes: Open — E2 drain fault
Retractor jam with normal ohms
testingTips: Retractor also drives clutch — verify drain valve linkage

name: Insignia Frequency-Platform Drive Motor (WMT41)
purpose: WMT41 wash motor Yellow–Light blue and Blue–Light blue pairs.
failureModes: Open or unequal pairs — spin/agitate failure
Capacitor fault — verify capacitor discharge before test
testingTips: Both motor pairs should read 15–25 Ω
Check capacitor separately per manual §07

name: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU Wash Motor
purpose: ACU wash/circulation motor — W10751166 tech sheet (60 W).
failureModes: Open — F8 motor fuse / won't wash
Good ohms but no run — control relay or door switch
testingTips: Check F8 fuse if motor won't run
Disconnect from control before ohms test

name: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU Drain Motor
purpose: Dedicated drain motor winding — F9E1 drain faults.
failureModes: Open winding — won't drain
Normal ohms — check chopper, hose, check valve
testingTips: Verify F9 triac fuse if drain motor won't run

name: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU Tub Heater
purpose: Tub heating element — plastic ~805 W wet / SS ~785 W models.
failureModes: Open element — F4E2 / no heat
Hi-limit open — test bi-metal bypass only for heater test
testingTips: Plastic vs stainless wattage differs — both fall in 8–30 Ω band

name: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU Fill Valve Coil
purpose: Main fill valve solenoid — F8E1 fill faults.
failureModes: Open coil — no fill
Stuck open — overfill / float switch
testingTips: Clean inlet screen; verify house water pressure

name: Whirlpool/KitchenAid OWI Sensor NTC
purpose: OWI NTC at P12 — 46–52 kΩ at 77°F (25°C); 11–13 kΩ at 140°F.
failureModes: Open — F3E2 OWI fault
Out of band at room — sensor or harness
testingTips: Disconnect P12 before measuring NTC at pins 1–3
Clean OWI and drain loop check valve for F3E2

name: Insignia DWR3 Water Inlet Valve
purpose: NS-DWR3SS1 inlet solenoid — ~1 kΩ per service manual.
failureModes: Open coil — won't fill
Low pressure — fill timeout
testingTips: Verify water supply and inlet screen

name: Insignia DWR3 Drain Pump
purpose: NS-DWR3SS1 drain pump winding — manual lists ~25–35 Ω.
failureModes: Open — won't drain
Check valve stuck — sump retains water
testingTips: Verify O-ring on pump seal during reassembly

name: Insignia DWR3 Tub Heater
purpose: NS-DWR3SS1 heating element — ~10–15 Ω.
failureModes: Open element — no heat during wash/dry
Thermistor default timing if sensor fails
testingTips: Disconnect power before element ohms test

name: Insignia DWR3 Tub Thermistor
purpose: R@25°C = 10 kΩ ±2%; R@60°C ≈ 3 kΩ per DWR3 manual.
failureModes: Open — default heat timing, poor dry
Short — overheating risk
testingTips: NTC negative coefficient — resistance drops as tub heats

name: LG LDT Vario Diverter Motor
purpose: Vario cam motor — VARIO ERROR when position switch fails; ~4 kΩ winding.
failureModes: Open — VARIO ERROR, poor top-rack wash
Switch misposition — cam not seated
testingTips: Remove 2 screws; verify vario switch and cam before motor replacement

name: Midea/Insignia B3839 NTC Thermistor
purpose: B3839 R/T table — ~2.0 kΩ at 25°C; lower than generic 5–16 kΩ cabinet NTC.
failureModes: Open — E1/E2 sensor faults
Out of band at room — wrong sensor type assumed
testingTips: Use §9.4 R/T table in NS-RSS26 service manual
Do not apply generic 5–16 kΩ refrigerator band to B3839

name: Midea RSS26 Freezer Defrost Heater
purpose: 115 V 240 W defrost heater — R ≈ 55 Ω calculated.
failureModes: Open heater — frost buildup, E5/E6 defrost faults
Good heater — check defrost sensor and control
testingTips: Disconnect heater before ohms test
Verify defrost sensor on evaporator top

name: Midea UZ21 Freezer Defrost Heater
purpose: NS-UZ21 115 V 320 W defrost heater — R ≈ 41 Ω.
failureModes: Open heater — frost, E5/E6 family codes
Heater OK — defrost sensor or timer board
testingTips: UZ21 uses fixed-speed compressor EZ90H1A — different from RSS inverter

name: Insignia TDRE75 Electric Heater
purpose: NS-TDRE75W1 heating element — 20 Ω per service manual.
failureModes: Open element — no heat (E4/E5 may appear later)
Thermal fuse open — check exhaust vent
testingTips: Run NTC test mode (04) before condemning main PCB

name: Insignia TDRE75 Outlet NTC
purpose: Outlet thermistor — ~50 kΩ at 77°F; E5 outlet sensor fault.
failureModes: Open — E5 mid-cycle heat loss
Wrong reading — vent restriction mimics sensor fault
testingTips: Verify vent path before sensor replacement
Table: 40 kΩ @ 86°F, 99 kΩ @ 50°F

name: Whirlpool CCU Electric Dryer Element (Dual)
purpose: Both elements in parallel ≤50 Ω per CCU tech sheet; single element ~20 Ω.
failureModes: Open — no heat
One element open — long dry times
testingTips: Relay #1 violet to relay #2 violet — ≤50 Ω both elements
Verify L1 and L2 present at control on electric
